items.title: Buddy Burns Interview, 1958-08-14
items.q: Richard McClane, he started me reading.

ctx.x: You say some of these men helped you to read, so you learned to read music then too?

Yes, yes. Well, the first one really learned me how to... I had been, you know, spelling a little bit and Richard McClane, he started me reading. And then I got with Pinchback and he showed me the rest. And then I goes on to this guy, Wilcox, and he showed me some about reading, so that's how I learned how to read. Did you ever find that big WPA band they had during the... No, I, no, no, I couldn't get on the WPA. They wouldn't ever put me on. No. No, they wouldn't put me in that band. And a lot of musicians.…
Your wife came from downtown, you're saying you moved downtown later.
